# Be Languages

> Be Languages is a language school and certified translation service on Isla Colón, Bocas del Toro, Panama. It offers personalized private Spanish and English classes (in person in Bocas del Toro, or online from anywhere in Panama and abroad) and certified English-Spanish document translation. Classes are taught by a certified local instructor and tailored to expats, digital nomads, travelers, locals and professionals, from complete beginner to advanced.

Website: https://www.be-languages.com
Spanish version: https://www.be-languages.com/es
Languages of service: English, Spanish
Location: Isla Colón, Bocas del Toro, Panama (online classes available across Panama)
Phone / WhatsApp: +507 6613-5652
Email: be.languages.pa@gmail.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/be.languages/
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 18:00

## Services

- [Spanish classes in Bocas del Toro](https://www.be-languages.com/spanish-classes-in-isla-colon-bocas-del-toro): private Spanish lessons focused on real Panamanian Spanish, for all levels, in person or online.
- [English classes in Bocas del Toro](https://www.be-languages.com/english-classes-in-isla-colon-bocas-del-toro): private English lessons for locals, professionals and students, in person or online.
- [Online Spanish classes in Panama](https://www.be-languages.com/online-spanish-classes-panama): live 1-on-1 Spanish lessons by video call for expats and travelers anywhere in Panama.
- [Online English classes in Panama](https://www.be-languages.com/online-english-classes-panama): live 1-on-1 English lessons by video call, including business English and job interview practice.
- [Certified translation services](https://www.be-languages.com/certified-translation-services-in-isla-colon-bocas-del-toro): certified English-Spanish translation of legal, academic, immigration, medical, personal and business documents. From $15 per page, typically 2 to 3 business days.

## Spanish class pricing (USD)

- 1 Week Crash Course: $125 (5 hours)
- Island Flow Plan: $150 (3 weeks, 6 hours)
- Steady Surf Plan: $180 (1 month, 8 hours)
- Buddy Boost (2 people): $320 (1 month)
